The owner's design of mitcad#2141 (opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/loft-circle-slot-reported-test.cmake): on XZ a circle of radius 50 (Sketch1 F1), a plane 100 along Y (Plane1 F5) with a centre-point slot on it (Sketch2 F6, arc centres 73 either side, radius 21), and Loft1 (F7) from the slot to the circle. Shelled 2 mm inside with the slot's end removed, Sharp, the shell failed ('the offset faces do not close up'): the loft's faces met at creases along the lines between them. Now they are tangent there and the shell builds, with no warning or information.
